hni_signals: Among the strongest HNI profiles in this batch. Departmental owner: 'Director and Head of Urology and Renal Transplantation at AIG Hospitals'. TWO PUBLICLY STATED PROCEDURE VOLUMES, quoted verbatim: 'has performed more than 1000 transplants on his own which includes complex kidney transplants like 2nd and 3rd transplant', and 'is a pioneer in retroperitoneoscopic donor nephrectomy and has performed more than 1000 retroperitoneoscopic donor nephrectomies'. Described publicly as a pioneer of the retroperitoneoscopic donor nephrectomy technique. PROFESSORSHIP: former Professor of Urology and Transplantation Surgery at IKDRC-ITS Ahmedabad, India's largest and most prestigious kidney transplant institute. Runs premium high-capex service lines including robotic kidney transplant and robotic radical nephrectomy; featured in Telangana Today press coverage of a robotic kidney tumour removal at AIG - a media appearance. MULTI-LOCATION / OUTREACH PRACTICE: publicly announced as a visiting consultant running an OP clinic in Assam ('Renowned Urologist Dr. Bipin Chandra Pal from AIG Hospital Hyderabad will visit...'), i.e. he draws referral practice beyond Telangana. BOARD AND SOCIETY MEMBERSHIPS: Urological Society of India, European Association of Urology, Indian Society of Organ Transplantation; registered with the Bihar Medical Council. Qualifications: MBBS Rajendra Medical College Ranchi, MS General Surgery S N Medical College Agra, MCh Urology JIPMER Puducherry, DNB Urology NBE New Delhi. Listed on the Government of India's Advantage Healthcare directory of India-facing specialist consultants.

notes:
NAME-FORM RECONCILIATION: the source row gives 'Dr. Bipin Chandrapal'; AIG, the government directory and every other source render it as the spaced form 'Dr. Bipin Chandra Pal' (surname Pal, given names Bipin Chandra). Same person - specialty matches the source row almost word for word ('Urology, Kidney Transplantation and Andrology' vs the published 'Urologist, Andrologist and Kidney Transplant Surgeon' / 'Director and Head of Urology and Renal Transplantation'), plus hospital (AIG), city (Hyderabad) and campus (Gachibowli) all match. Not treated as ambiguous. Caution for downstream matching: 'Bipin Chandra Pal' is also the name of a famous Indian independence-era nationalist leader with a Wikipedia article, which surfaced in results and is a different person entirely from a different century - do not let that contaminate this record.

Identity verified on four criteria across TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL sources that agree: (1) aighospitals.com, the hospital's own site, page title 'Dr. Bipin Chandra Pal - Urology & Kidney Transplant Expert at AIG Hospitals'; (2) healinindia.gov.in, the Government of India's Advantage Healthcare directory, listing him as 'Dr. Bipin Chandra Pal - Urology in AIG Hospitals'. A .gov.in registry is independent of the hospital, so the High band is properly earned. LinkedIn, Skedoc and HexaHealth are corroborating only and were not counted.

AIG URL note: the clean form https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/dr-bipin-chandra-pal was returned verbatim as a result URL and is recorded as hospital_profile. A second AIG page for him, https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-bipin-chandra-pal, was returned only percent-encoded inside a Google Translate wrapper URL; rather than decode and 'clean' it (which would edge toward constructing a URL), the translate URL is recorded verbatim under other_profiles exactly as it came back. A third result, http://13.200.33.93/doctors/dr-bipin-chandra-pal/ titled 'Dr Bipin Chandra Pal Urology Andrology - AIG Hospitals', is evidently an AIG origin/staging server exposed by raw IP; it corroborates the /doctors/<slug> URL family but is NOT recorded as a profile because a bare-IP staging host is not a legitimate published address.

NO email or phone recorded. AIG publishes no per-doctor phone or email; no published personal contact surfaced. The two Facebook items are third-party (Assam Healthcare's page announcing his visiting clinic), not his own account, so they are recorded under other_profiles as evidence of outreach practice rather than in the facebook field. No Practo profile surfaced for him.

Procedure volumes ('more than 1000 transplants', 'more than 1000 retroperitoneoscopic donor nephrectomies') are quoted verbatim from public profile text, never estimated. owns_clinic false: he is a Director/HOD inside AIG and a visiting consultant elsewhere, but no personally owned clinic, practice entity or personal website was found - a human may wish to check whether the Assam visiting clinic is his own venture, which would change this flag.
